subject: Asset exchange + MAP: evaluation datasets, prompt pack & test-case constraints
messages:
From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@olivehealth.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: samir.patel@olivehealth.com
Date: Fri, 08 May 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: exchanging evaluation assets & proposed MAP

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising. Our evaluation lead (Samir) and I discussed next steps: we'd like to exchange a small assessment corpus + a prompt pack and put a short mutual action plan (MAP) around timelines, usage constraints, and signoffs.

High-level asks from our side:
- We will share 3k anonymized patient-support chat examples and ~60 targeted prompts (prompt pack).
- We need a written guarantee that Redwood will only use the dataset for the Olive evaluation and not for model training beyond the agreed scope.
- Timeline: 3-week technical evaluation (staging), followed by review/cost discussion.

Attached is a brief spec listing formats and file manifest (olive_eval_spec_v1.xlsx). Can you confirm Redwood's standard MAP and any legal/NDAs we should expect? Also please outline the onboarding steps and the docs your team will need to accept the assets.

Best,
Alice Turner
Director, AI Strategy
Olive Health

Attachments: olive_eval_spec_v1.xlsx (Excel, 12 KB)

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@olivehealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: exchanging evaluation assets & proposed MAP

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear spec and for sending this over. Happy to run the asset exchange and MAP; outlined below is our suggested lightweight process so we can move quickly while protecting both parties.

Proposed steps (high-level):
1) Sign a Mutual Evaluation Agreement (one-page) + one-way NDA for asset protection (we can do DocuSign).
2) Olive uploads assets to a secure intake link (we'll provide a temporary S3 endpoint + instructions).
3) Redwood performs a staging onboarding (checksum verification, schema validation, minimal sampling) within 3 business days of receipt.
4) Technical evaluation window: 3 weeks in Redwood staging with pinned model + observable metrics.
5) Final review call, quality notes, and optional 2-week extension.

Key constraints we require (draft language):
- Use-limited clause: Redwood will only process and store Olive-provided datasets for the purpose of this evaluation and will not use the raw contents to further train or adapt publicly available models. Aggregated telemetry (e.g., prompt-level latency) may be retained for platform ops.
- Retention: Raw upload retained for 60 days post-eval unless Olive requests earlier deletion.
- Redistribution: Redwood will not redistribute or publish the dataset; extracts required for bug repro will be redacted and shared only with Olive reviewers.

I've attached a Redwood MAP draft and a placeholder prompt-pack template (prompt-pack-v1.zip) to illustrate expected formatting.

Next steps: if that approach works, I'll kick off a DocuSign for the two short agreements and provide the secure upload link. Neha (cc) will coordinate procurement details/quotes. Rafael (cc) will be the technical lead on onboarding.

—
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_20260511.docx, prompt-pack-v1.zip

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@olivehealth.com>, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: exchanging evaluation assets & proposed MAP

Hi Alice — quick note from procurement/GT.

We can support the 3-week evaluation under a zero-cost pilot (internal promo credit) for the initial staging. After the evaluation, pricing will be based on sustained throughput/TPU hours and model selection. I'll prepare a short commercial one-pager and include options for Dedicated vs Hosted if Olive prefers isolation for PHI-like workloads.

Laura — can you add a line item estimating 3 weeks of staging with pinned model rdx-13b-quant? Rafael — please include expected onboarding lead time in hours for the intake validation.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@olivehealth.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: samir.patel@olivehealth.com
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: exchanging evaluation assets & proposed MAP

Connor/Neha — this looks good and thanks for the quick draft. A couple of clarifications before we sign:

1) Can you expand the retention clause to allow a 30-day destruction window post-eval by default, with a longer retention only on express written consent?
2) We need a short audit clause that we (Olive) can run a one-time review of logs showing access to the uploaded artifacts during the evaluation.
3) Regarding IP: Olive requires that prompts and datasets remain Olive's IP; Redwood's derived model outputs may be logged for debugging but cannot be used for training.

Samir has zipped the prompt pack and included a manifest; uploading now (prompt-pack-v1.zip). Let us know when the intake link is live and we'll complete the upload.

Best,
Alice

Attachments: prompt-pack-v1.zip (ZIP, 3.4 MB)

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@olivehealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: exchanging evaluation assets & proposed MAP

Hi Alice — thanks, all valid asks and straightforward to incorporate. Summary of agreed changes we've applied to the draft MAP: 

- Retention: default 30-day destruction window post-eval. Any extension requires express written consent from Olive (we added a checkbox in the DocuSign).
- Audit: we will provide a one-time access log export (S3 access + who/when) for the evaluation period; logs will be redacted for internal staff IDs and delivered as CSV.
- IP: we accepted the ownership clause for the assets; Redwood will not use raw prompts/datasets for training. Aggregated non-attributable telemetry (timings, token counts) retained for ops.

I've sent the two short agreements via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/link/TPA-olive-2026 — please sign when convenient. Intake link (temporary): https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-intake/olive-health-2026 (expires in 7 days).

Rafael: onboarding estimate?
Rafael Mendes (reply inline):
> Onboarding estimate: 8–12 engineer hours for validation, sampling, and test-run; target T+3 business days to confirm ingestion.

Next milestone (MAP):
- Day 0: DocuSign complete + asset upload
- +3 business days: Redwood confirms ingestion and posts initial health report
- +21 days: evaluation end; review call and results deck

I'll update the HubSpot deal and mark the MAP as sent (Deal: RDW-OLV-2026-0421). Thanks — excited to run this with you.

—
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
